summary.en: Build valid is-a relationships with extends and trace superclass construction.
summary.bn: extends দিয়ে is-a সম্পর্ক গড়ুন এবং সুপারক্লাসের constructor কখন চলে তা দেখুন।

notes: Java 17 requires an explicit super(...) or this(...) invocation first in its constructor.

sections.title: A more specific kind of student
Declare the relationship and initialize its state
Trace the constructor chain before the child body
Follow the parent work in each result
Check the relationship before fixing the syntax

examples.title: A scholarship student is a student
examples.explanationHtml: The Scholar constructor passes 42 to Student. The inherited roll() method reads the private state through Student behaviour.

examples.title: Watch three constructor levels
examples.explanationHtml: Implicit super() calls reach Person first. Constructor bodies then finish from the oldest superclass toward LabTutor.

examples.title: Extend a parent method
examples.explanationHtml: super.label() deliberately calls Pass.label(). The child appends a department label to its result.

examples.title: Two branches share a parent
examples.explanationHtml: Bus and Bike form hierarchical inheritance. Neither branch inherits the other branch’s implementation.

practice.title: Scholarship total
practice.statementHtml: Read roll (1..9999), base grant and extra grant (each 0..10000). Make Award hold the base and ScholarAward extend it. Print roll and total on separate lines.
hints: Pass base to super before storing extra.

practice.title: Three-level fare
practice.statementHtml: Read distance (0..100), rate (0..100) and discount (0..100). Journey stores distance, MeteredJourney adds a rate, and StudentJourney subtracts discount without going below zero. Print the fare.
hints: Keep the distance field private and expose its value through a method.

practice.title: Choose a hierarchy
practice.statementHtml: A Library holds Books and an EBook is a Book. Draw the valid inheritance arrow and explain the other relation.
practice.answerHtml:
EBook --|> Book
Library -- holds --> Book

An EBook can fulfil the Book contract. A Library contains books but cannot replace one. Library therefore needs a reference or collection, not extends Book.
hints: Ask whether a caller expecting Book can accept the proposed subclass.

practice.title: Repair constructor chaining
practice.statementHtml: Parent has only Parent(int code). Child declares Child() with an empty body. Explain the error and write the constructor fragment that passes code 7.
practice.answerHtml:
Child() {
    super(7);
}

The empty constructor would call super() implicitly. Parent has no no-argument constructor. Passing 7 selects the existing Parent(int) constructor.
hints: An omitted superclass call becomes super() in Java 17.

quiz.prompt: Which constructor body prints first when new C() finishes?
quiz.explanation: Construction reaches A before the B and C bodies run.

quiz.prompt: How does super.cost() contribute to the child fare?
quiz.explanation: The child calls the parent implementation and subtracts five from forty.

quiz.prompt: Does an inherited method use the parent constructor’s saved value?
quiz.explanation: Child passes ten into Parent; value() reads that stored ten.

quiz.prompt: Which relationship supports Scholar extends Student?
quiz.explanation: An is-a relation requires substitutability from child to parent.
options: Every Scholar can satisfy the Student contract

quiz.prompt: What does Java 17 require of an explicit super(...) constructor call?
quiz.explanation: Constructor chaining starts with this(...) or super(...); a super call selects the direct superclass constructor.
options: It is the first statement of that constructor
It can appear inside an if block
It calls an arbitrary ancestor constructor

quiz.prompt: Which member does a child constructor call rather than inherit?
quiz.explanation: Constructors are not inherited, although child construction invokes a parent constructor.

quiz.prompt: What inheritance shape is Person to Student to Tutor?
quiz.explanation: The inheritance chain passes through more than one superclass level.

quiz.prompt: Why can a class not write extends Printer, ScannerDevice?
quiz.explanation: One class superclass avoids conflicting superclass state and implementation paths; multiple interfaces remain possible.
options: Only final classes can be parents
Java permits only one direct class superclass

quiz.prompt: Can a child method directly name a private field declared in a separate parent class?
quiz.explanation: The parent controls private access; a method can expose suitable behaviour without exposing storage.
options: No; use an accessible parent operation
Yes, because extends makes it protected
Only when the object was upcast

quiz.prompt: What is the immediate superclass when a normal class declares no extends clause?
quiz.explanation: Object is the root class, except that Object itself has no superclass.

keyPoints.en: extends declares an is-a relationship, not ownership.
keyPoints.bn: extends দিয়ে is-a সম্পর্ক বোঝায়, মালিকানা নয়।

keyPoints.en: Superclass constructors run as part of child construction.
keyPoints.bn: চাইল্ড তৈরির সময় সুপারক্লাসের constructor-ও চলে।

keyPoints.en: super.method() selects the parent implementation explicitly.
keyPoints.bn: super.method() লিখে প্যারেন্টের নির্দিষ্ট মেথড চালানো যায়।

keyPoints.en: Java classes have one direct class superclass.
keyPoints.bn: জাভায় একটি ক্লাসের সরাসরি ক্লাস সুপারক্লাস একটিই হয়।

keyPoints.en: Keep parent state private and expose meaningful operations.
keyPoints.bn: প্যারেন্টের ডেটা private রাখুন এবং দরকারি কাজের মেথড দিন।

examQuestions.question: Draw single, multilevel and hierarchical inheritance using campus roles.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
Single: Scholar --|> Student
Multilevel: Tutor --|> Scholar --|> Student
Hierarchical: Scholar --|> Student <|-- Athlete

The hollow triangle points toward the more general class. Each proposed role must preserve Student behaviour.

examQuestions.question: Explain why Java does not support multiple class inheritance and how interfaces help.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Two parent classes could provide competing implementations and state paths. Java chooses one direct class superclass. A class may implement multiple interfaces to promise several capabilities. Conflicting interface default methods still need an explicit resolution.

examQuestions.question: Trace construction when Tutor() calls super(12) and Student(int) prints its argument first.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Student construction runs before the Tutor constructor body. Student prints 12, then Tutor prints whatever its own body requests. The Student constructor is called, not inherited.
